name: Cuddle Season
summary: Three wannabe ladies' men set out to add women to their winter rosters. But when their plans backfire, they risk being left without cuddle buddies.

name: Mysterious Disappearances
summary: Sumireko Ogawa is a busty bookstore clerk who wants to become a novelist after some writing success in her youth. When strange occurrences start cropping up around the city, she teams up with her flirtatious co-worker Ren Adashino to look into them. But Ren is hiding a secret of his own! With their combined skills of occult knowledge, what will they discover as they investigate?

previousepisode.name: A Ticket, a Video, and Mysterious Disappearances

name: Fly-High and Huggy
summary: Join Fly-High and Huggy on their mighty adventures to deliver the golden nut to the King.

previousepisode.name: Do Not Press the Red Button

name: The Mighty Hercules
summary: Adventures of TV's mythical hero and his faithful companions Helena, Newton and Tewt against the forces of Daedalus, the wizard and Wilamene, the sea witch.

name: Переведи ее через Майдан
summary: Достаточно быстро обычное уголовное дело превращается в запутанный политический триллер: Мельник оказывается в гуще интриг на самом верху. Любовь и смерть, предательство и преданность в контексте исторического госпереворота, сломавшего судьбы многих людей и разбросавшего их по разные стороны баррикад.

name: Mr Bloom's Nursery
summary: Gardener Mr Bloom welcomes a team of young helpers, who tend to his plants and produce.

name: Mr Bloom: Here and There
summary: Join Mr Bloom as he travels around the UK to meet Tiddlers.

name: Mr Bloom's Nursery: Get Set, Grow!
summary: Mr Bloom's Nursery: Get Set, Grow! sees Mr Bloom pack up his Compo Car and head out across the country to set up a travelling village fete for hundreds of Tiddlers.

name: Tajemnice polskich fortun
summary: At a time when store shelves in Poland are empty, a few successful people with a mind for business find a way to earn huge amounts of money.

name: The Daily Report with John Dickerson
summary: John Dickerson provides in-depth reporting on news stories and interviews newsmakers.

name: Alien Files Reopened
summary: Alien Files Reopened takes the UFO and Extraterrestrial Phenomenon to the next level by using investigation techniques to figure out exactly what the history is behind the mystery of some of the most well-known, extraordinary cases of the last 75 years.

name: Damena Otoko ja Dame Desu ka?
summary: In which a good-looking college student, Gonta Tamachi, reconsiders himself when his powerful grandmother and his body and spirit are replaced.

name: Högspänning
summary: Follow behind the scenes of Sweden's energy supply, where the brave workers carry out difficult work at a height of one hundred meters and in extreme weather conditions, where every mistake can be life-threatening.

name: Dazzling Him
summary: Sweet girl Xuan Yi stumbled upon her boyfriend being unfaithful. After the heartbreak, a twist of fate led her to become the personal assistant of the popular male idol, Long Yi. She assisted Long Yi on his journey to transform into a serious actor, accompanying him through various challenges, and ultimately helping him achieve his dream of transformation, while also finding a genuine love of her own.

name: Blossom
summary:
After losing her mother at a young age, Dou Zhao became deeply disillusioned with love and family due to the upheavals and hardships she faced. To protect herself and her family estate, she contended with her stepmother and chose to live in a remote village, focusing on her studies to become self-reliant. One stormy night, Dou Zhao encountered Song Mo, disguised as a merchant, at the village. Using her wit, she helped him protect the orphaned descendant of Duke Dingguo, who had been honored for his achievements in quelling bandits. This incident intertwined their fates.
Song Mo, born into an official's family, was entangled in the mysteries of his family's downfall. Meanwhile, Dou Zhao faced malicious rumors about an arranged marriage orchestrated by her stepmother. To form an alliance and navigate their difficulties, they decided to marry. Initially suspicious of each other, they gradually became confidants and supported each other through numerous challenges.
Unexpectedly, political turmoil loomed, forcing Dou Zhao and Song Mo to confront the crises together. They worked to save their families, uncover the truth behind the switched children at the Duke's residence, thwart Prince Liao's rebellion, exonerate loyal ministers, and ensure the nation's peace. Ultimately, they found true happiness, living a life that was genuinely their own.

name: The Road to Splendor
summary: Zhao Ling, a bold and loyal underground salt dealer, may come from humble origins, but he carries grand ambitions. He crosses paths with Fu Tingyun, a noble heiress wrongfully accused of an illicit affair. Forced to flee together, they face trials from both family and court. Battling against fate, their bond grows through hardship eventually forging a legendary love.

name: Above the Rivers
summary: Judges Geng Nian and Luo Yuan got together because of an environmental protection case in which farmers sued chemical companies for sewage discharge. Through this case, they met public interest lawyer Xia Weidong. The three worked together and had a useful discussion during the trial of the environmental protection case

name: Blossom Campus
summary: Kim Minjae, a 21-year-old transfer student from Practical Music and a part-time worker, exudes a calm, meticulous, and thoughtful demeanor. His path continually intersects with Yoonchan's, whom he encountered by chance on his first day at the new school. Meanwhile, Lee Yoonchan, a 21-year-old Taekwondo major at Hankook University's College of Sports Culture and Arts, is introverted and somewhat clumsy, but his endearing silliness adds to his charm. A chance encounter between them leads to their paths intertwining, and over time, their bond deepens, blossoming into a romantic relationship.

name: Jazz for Two
summary: Taeyi hears a familiar melody fill the empty halls and makes his way to the old music room. He knows his brother is dead, but he can't help but hope, maybe, just maybe…it's his brother playing his favorite song. When he slams open the door, however, he finds Seheon, the new transfer student, at the piano. Disappointment comes crashing down and Taeyi can't control his anger. How dare Seheon play his brother's song? How dare he smile? How dare he say he loves jazz? "If I ever catch you playing the piano again…that'll be the end of you." And with that begins Taeyi and Seheon's story, as unpredictable and visceral as jazz.

name: Engineering Evolved
summary: Engineering Evolved takes you on a captivating ride through the evolution of transportation. From high-speed trains to submarines, each episode uncovers the engineering marvels that shape our world.

name: Fully Booked
summary: It's never before seen! Six idols from GMMTV will fly across the sky to open a Thai restaurant in Japan! Cook, serve, and run, they'll get it all done from the beginning to the end without any help! Stay tuned to see how this adventure will turn out.

name: With Love With You
summary: It tells the story of Wang Yan (played by Tong Yao), an urban strong woman who is versatile and resolute in her career, and Wang Lingjun (played by Zhou Yiran), a rebellious sister who breaks into Shenzhen with "a proud personality". They both experience workplace turmoil in a big city. After a romantic entanglement, he puts aside his inner grudges and re-examines himself, and finally achieves a story of two-way redemption.

name: Book Club
summary: Book Club is a review series which dips into the conversations of book clubs from across the country as they discuss literary classics, the latest releases and club favourites.

name: Travel Guides New Zealand
summary: Explore one of the most amazing places in the world - our home! Rediscover our magical country through the eyes of ordinary Kiwis on extraordinary adventures.

name: Purk
summary: Lisa is a hard-working narcotics investigator with a strong sense of justice, a heart for those close to her, and an ever so slight anger management problem.

name: Svenska scoop
summary: Big revelations and sensational news that made an impression and created debate. But what actually happened? The program recounts and goes behind the scenes together with the journalists behind some of Sweden's biggest scoops.

name: Tryouts
summary: Tryouts delves into the heart of America's most intense and high-stakes tryouts, competitions, and auditions, offering viewers a front row seat into the make-or-break moments of real-life hopefuls who are putting everything at stake to secure a coveted spot with the team, group, or organization of their dreams.

name: Down in the Valley
summary: Down in the Valley will take viewers on a tantalizing tour of the Deep South, unveiling a complex South that is equal parts poignant, joyful, and magical. Down in the Valley will pull back the curtain on the surprising but always intriguing people and places that make the Deep South a place where anything can happen and usually does.

name: Kiseki Chapter 2
summary:
Miracle…It might just be spiritual anchor for someone but in this Fall foliage time in Japan, it becomes a time for love that blooms in their hearts. Four leaf clover is going to be a symbol of good memories for them in Kiseki, Season of Miracle. 

Four leaf clovers are said to stand for faith, hope, love, and luck.

The park in Tokyo is filled with fresh atmosphere of nature in the fall season, P sits and wait for his friend Beboy take a picture and having fun with his first time in Japan; he hasn't been aboard before. 

In this traveling, they accidentally meet two guys, twins named Pan and Plai that come to Japan in different objective. By the time they meet and are getting closer, they have learned a lot about meaning of life. In a short time, six days, many things happened and filled some things in their hearts, in the end their time together is running out, but their memories still remain in their hearts and their feelings will continue.

name: The MacKenzies of Paradise Cove
summary: A reluctant fisherman becomes the unofficial guardian of five orphaned children.

previousepisode.name: The Agony of Victory, the Joy of Defeat

name: In Hope
summary: When TV presenter Yasar meets her new neighbour, little does she know that him moving in is no mere coincidence, and her twenty-year-old secret is about to be revealed…

name: One Room, Hiatari Futsuu, Tenshi-tsuki.
summary: Shintaro Tokumitsu is a high schooler living all alone, but things take an unexpected turn when a girl named Towa shows up on his balcony! Not only is she incredibly pure and sweet, but there's something different about her—something...divine. Just who is Shintaro's new roommate, and what adorable high jinks lie in store?!

name: Реки
summary: The 12-episode expedition along the rivers. Beautiful. Informative. Colorful.

name: Children of Badea'a
summary: Five siblings live with their mother (Badiea) in a popular neighborhood in Damascus, where she makes great efforts to raise her children and provide them with a decent life. Each of them also faces many difficulties and challenges in their quest to achieve their different dreams.

name: Sea Change: The Gulf of Maine, a NOVA Special Presentation
summary: 7500 miles long, 1000 feet deep, stretching from Cape Cod to Nova Scotia, the Gulf of Maine is a 36,000 square mile underwater Eden whose abundance drove the development of colonies, states and a nation, changed the way we lived. Today, this treasure is in peril. Warming faster than 97% of the global ocean, what happens here will likely happen everywhere. This is far more than a story of peril – it's also a story of remarkable biodiversity and adaptation. Over three episodes, we meet scientists, fishers, native Americans and innovators working to help the Gulf bounce back. A three-part NOVA special presentation premiering July 24, 2024 at 10 pm on PBS.

previousepisode.name: Sea Change: Survival in the Gulf of Maine

name: Viral Hit
summary: Scrawny high school student Hobin Yu is probably the last guy you'd expect to star in a NewTube channel that revolves around fighting. But after following some advice from a mysterious NewTube channel, Hobin is soon knocking out guys stronger than him and raking in more money than he could have ever dreamed of. Can Hobin keep this up, or will he eventually meet his match?

name: Boku no Tsuma wa Kanjo ga nai
summary: Takuma is a single guy who does nothing but go to work and come home. Too tired to do chores, he decides to get a robot to cook and keep house. "Mina-chan" is such a good housekeeper, Takuma jokes that she should become his wife. Mina takes Takuma's joke seriously, and slowly the two start doing more things together, like having a picnic outside. As time goes by, Takuma starts to fall for Mina, but can a human and a robot ever have an equal, loving relationship?

name: The Housewives War
summary: Han Xingyue, a senior executive, chose to resign and became a full-time housewife for her child. But she found that her husband, Ding Bo, cheated on her and transferred the property. She gave everything to her family, and it turned out so bad. Therefore, she didn't want to put up with it and used her wisdom as a senior executive to battle with Ding Bo. It was a battle of wits and courage. She made a self-refinement and turned the table, finding a new direction for housewives to balance family and career.

name: City of Light Battle Alliance
summary: In a city of light that never sees sunlight all year round, Lin Feng was influenced by his father, Dr. Helium, since he was a child. He realized that the city of light was not a refuge for humans, but had become a cage trapping humans. Lin Feng formed a fighting alliance and took desperate risks to fight to the death with Mr. Krypton, the big boss behind the scenes, and bring the sunshine back to the City of Light.

name: Animal Special Forces
summary: What else can we call animals that exploit their unbelievably sharp senses, phenomenal strength, and speed to complete their daily survival missions? From tiny spiders to enormous whales, these are evolution's heroes, the soldiers on the front lines. Life in the wild is life during wartime, and these animals have mastered the tactics of surveillance, stealth, attack, and defense.

name: Drunk to Love You
summary: Jiang Lu, who also claimed to never get drunk, gave Liu Yali a taste of meeting her match, and for the first time in a long while, she found herself "drunk" on the spot. Awakening from her "hangover," Liu Yali vowed to find Jiang Lu, only to discover that the enigmatic man Jiang Lu was actually her new boss that she had never met before! There seems to be more than meets the eye behind his ability to "hold his liquor"...

name: Дієта №0
summary: The main characters of the series are an unremarkable medical student Vanya and a moody beauty Margo, with whom he is hopelessly in love. They meet at sea and accidentally spend the night together, but the poor guy, self-conscious about his appearance and extra pounds, has no chance of being favored by a rich and self-confident girl. Many years later, fate gives them a second chance. Now Ivan is a slender handsome man and a famous nutritionist, and Margo is a single mother who has lost her home and her usual wealth. Will they recognize each other and finally be able to start their relationship from scratch?

name: Side Hustlers
summary: Women entrepreneurs develop their side hustles in the hopes of quitting their day jobs to pursue their dream careers full time.

name: Ring by Spring
summary: Texas State University students participate in a decades-old tradition of finding their future spouses and getting engaged before they graduate.

name: Good Cop/Bad Cop
summary: Good Cop/Bad Cop is a one-hour procedural dramedy centered around Lou and Henry, an odd couple sister and brother detective team in a small Pacific Northwest police force. They must contend with colorful residents, a serious lack of resources, and their very complicated dynamic with each other and with their police chief, Big Hank - who happens to be their father.

name: Khu Phra Khu Nang
summary: Orphan Din loves to sing and dance Yikay; it's at the centre of his life and soul. The path to Yikay hero, however, is not easy. Being faced with the disdain of others only ignites Din's ambition to climb from the earth to the stars. His vision of the life he wants includes Sano, a persevering young woman and his biggest supporter. From earth to the stars she's loved him alone, before he was beloved by many.

name: Legend of the Hidden Land
summary: When Khem, the Phu Lang Ka National Park staff, realizes the truth about her background with a vital mission at hand, she must return to gather all nine Maneenopparats.

name: Take My Tumor
summary:
Take My Tumor featuring three doctors removing tumors from patients with extreme cases. Experts in their field and renowned surgeons, Dr. Kimberly Moore Dalal, Dr. Jason Cohen, and Dr. Ryan F. Osborne take on some of the most challenging cases of their careers.

Patients from all over the world, including a man with a tumor rapidly growing out of his neck and a woman covered in over a thousand tumors from her head to her toes, are looking to get their lives back and these surgeons are their last hope. This intense series highlights unique patients, difficult surgeries, and life-changing procedures.

previousepisode.name: The Man with the Spicy Tumor

name: El Hashaashun
summary: Hassan Al Sabah assembled a group of the most devoted adherents of the Ismailia creed. They terrorized the hearts of monarchs and rulers and have assassinated several important historical figures.

name: Meem Empire
summary: Raising six children alone is not easy for widower Mokhtar. Now, what if love knocked at his door amidst all that chaos?

name: Spice and Wolf: Merchant Meets the Wise Wolf
summary: Lawrence is a travelling merchant selling various goods from a horse-drawn cart. One day, he arrives at a village and meets a beautiful girl with the ears and tail of an animal! Her name is Holo the Wisewolf and she brings bountiful harvests. She wishes to return to her homeland, and Lawrence offers to take her. Now, the once-lonely merchant and the once-lonely wisewolf begin their journey north.

name: Tonari no Youkai-san
summary: Welcome to Engamori, the cozy town where supernatural beings are your friendly neighbors. For generations and to this day, the otherworldly Yokai and humans have continued to protect their easygoing way of life. Enjoy the mountain breeze and uncover the mysterious bonds that lie within.

name: Shuumatsu Train Doko e Iku?
summary: The story is set in a town in a not-so-ordinary countryside, where a big and strange occurrence is happening to its residents. But a young girl named Shizuru Chikura has a strong desire to see her lost friend again. Shizuru and three other girls board an abandoned train, and they set out to the outside world, where survival is not certain. What awaits them at the last stop of the "Doomsday Train?"

name: Blue Archive The Animation
summary: The city's academies are divided into their own districts and are considered mostly independent. The General Student Council acts as governing board to manage the academies as a whole. However, the group's ability to govern has come to halt since the mysterious disappearance of the General Student Council president. Countless issues have begun to surface throughout Kivotos in the absence of the president's leadership. To avoid disaster, the General Student Council requests assistance from the Federal Investigation Club, otherwise known as Schale. In fact, Schale is the city's newest club and the last to be approved before the president's disappearance.

name: Los gringo hunters
summary: Inspired by a real elite Mexican police unit that catches American fugitives on the run to Mexico, the fictional series Los gringo hunters will delve into the reality of the International Liaison Unit, with mysteries to solve, suspense, twists and turns, and the challenges and intrigue faced by this type of police operation.

previousepisode.name: #36 – Дина Аверина, Дмитрий Соловьев, Заурбек Байцаев, Андрей Минин, Азамат Мусагалиев

name: Shop Smart, Save Money
summary: Gaby Roslin and Ortis Deley help to find the right products at the right price.

name: Костя-Вера
summary: After the departure of the head of the family, Nikolai Petrovich, Kostya and Vera with their children move to a new apartment, and Galina Ivanovna to the cottage. Meanwhile, the search for himself forces Lenya to move first to her mother, and then to her younger brother. Masha's fiance Sergey will also share the living space with the Voronins. A simple guy from the province does not like Kostya, and now he, like Galina Ivanovna at the time, is looking for flaws in his future son-in-law in order to get rid of an unenviable match for his daughter.

name: Invisible Boys
summary:
Based on Holden Sheppard's award-winning novel of the same name, Invisible Boys follows three teenage boys in the coastal town of Geraldton, Western Australia, as they navigate their identities, friendships, and complex family dynamics. At the heart of Invisible Boys are Zeke, Charlie, and Hammer who are each grappling with their own challenges while seeking acceptance and belonging.

Set against the backdrop of the 2017 same-sex marriage plebiscite, the series explores the challenges faced by a group of gay teens in the remote coastal town of Geraldton, WA, after one of them is outed on social media following an encounter with a married man. As the group form a tight-knit friendship, the boys find solace and support in one another, exploring their desires and identities in a world that often renders them invisible.

name: Critical Incident
summary: A police officer pursuing a teenage suspect onto a busy train platform, knocks a bystander onto the train tracks, critically injuring them. As an intense investigation commences, the lives of the pursued and the pursuer are thrown into turmoil.

name: Exposure
summary: A mystery-thriller set in coastal New South Wales. It follows photographer Jacs Gould who, following the death of her best friend, returns to her hometown to discover the hidden secrets of their relationship and the truth behind her tragedy.

name: Thou Shalt Not Steal
summary: Searching for the truth behind a family secret, Robyn, a young Aboriginal delinquent, escapes from detention and reluctantly teams up with awkward teenager Gidge. Together, they flee on a perilous journey across the outback to find answers.

name: Одна безумная история
summary: "One Crazy Story" is a new show about the most incredible, adventurous and unusual experiments, initiatives and projects in the history of the USSR. In each episode, the host, Evgeniy Chebatkov, digs into stories about which one can only say, "What was that all about?"

name: Erro 404
summary: Rita has just lost her best friend and housemate. She is sad, unmotivated and apathetic when she discovers an app on her phone that allows her to live other people's lives. Needing to change something in her life, she decides to install Appy and embark on the various experiences that the application has to offer. However, Rita does not realize that the errors in the application, still in the experimental phase, will cause irreparable consequences in her life.

name: Inheritance: The Jersey Murders
summary:
Nicholas and Elizabeth Newall were bludgeoned to death in their St Brelade home in a crime which shocked the nation.

Their sons, Roderick and Mark Newall, were in their early 20s and inherited £900,000 after their parents' deaths. They were later convicted for their involvement in the murders and cover-up.

Roderick, a former British Army officer, received a life sentence for double murder, while Mark, an international banker, was convicted of assisting an offender and concealing the bodies.

Inheritance: The Jersey Murders explores the investigation into the Newall murders in October 1987, which features unheard taped recordings between the brothers and offers new insights into their actions and motivations.

name: Going Home with Tyler Cameron
summary: Going Home with Tyler Cameron he follows his dream of starting his own construction and home renovation company. After the sudden loss of his mother, Tyler moved back to his hometown, Jupiter, Florida, to reunite with his family and finally achieve his goal of launching his business, Image One. With the help of his team members – house-flipping expert, Robb Ritch, and Miami-based interior designer, Jessica Quintero – Tyler builds his company from the ground up, exceeding his clients' expectations one home renovation at a time.

name: Fetch the Vet
summary: Fetch the Vet tells the story of the day-to-day life of veterinarian Tom Fetch.

name: Coppola, El Representante
summary: Coppola, El Representante tells the story of Guillermo Coppola, a famous "bon vivant", and his struggles juggling a hectic private life with the demands of being the agent of Diego Armando Maradona, the world's most famous soccer player.

name: Black Twitter: A People's History
summary: Black Twitter: A People's History, this three-part docuseries charts the rise, movements, voices and memes that made Black Twitter an influential and dominant force in nearly every aspect of American political and cultural life.

name: Astro Note
summary: Takumi, a gifted chef, was just let go from his job. He lands a gig at an old boarding house called Astro-sou, but hesitates to accept after learning he must also live there full-time. That is until he meets the beautiful and charming caretaker, Mira, and he's sold. The two begin to work together and their connection deepens. But Mira has a secret: she isn't from this world!

name: Love in Devil
summary: Demon Lord, Lin Fangzun, annihilated the whole family of Zhao Lu on her wedding day. To save everybody, Zhao Lu went back 300 years and tried to kill Lin Fanfzun to avoid that previous tragedy. When she just arrived there, she accidentally saved Mu Ting who was held in captivity. So trying to requiting favors, Mu Ting helped Zhao Lu to find Lin Fangzun. However, it turned out Mu Ting was that Demon Lord...

name: My Piggy Lover
summary: A beautiful girl turns into a mini pig overnight? Zhu Zhu reluctantly decides to give away the mini pig "Oscar", just because her scumbag boyfriend Ou Kai intensely dislikes pigs! Zhu Zhu picks up Oscar and goes to a remote nighttime pet shop, where the ruffian-like owner agrees to take Oscar in. But Zhu Zhu is still ruthlessly ditched by the scumbag, and she bawls her eyes out and gets immensely drunk in the middle of the night. The next morning, she discovers that she has turned into a mini pig?! She is even in the pet shop? At the same time, her immediate superior Lu Ming appears at the shop entrance and gently adopts her away. Thereby, a fascinating little story unfolds…

name: O Ninho: Futebol & Tragédia
summary: After a tragic event at a youth football facility, grieving families demand answers and justice from Brazil's most popular team.

name: Ella Camina Sola
summary: ELLA CAMINA SOLA explores the story of Carla, a young high school teacher who is tasked with investigating allegations of sexual harassment against a colleague and friend, Ricardo. The allegations come as a shock to the school and her community, as Ricardo is a beloved teacher. Instinctively, Carla does not want to believe them, particularly since they were made by Daniela, a complicated and troubled student at the school. As she unravels the case and with the twists and turns of the plot, Carla flashes back to her adolescence. As she seeks justice in the present, Carla tries to heal the past.

name: Girls Band Cry
summary: The main character drops out of high school in her second year, and aims at entering a university while working alone in Tokyo. A girl is betrayed by her friends and doesn't know what to do. Another girl is abandoned by her parents, and tries to survive in the city by doing part-time jobs. This world lets us down all the time. Nothing goes as planned. But we want something that we can continue to like. We believe there's a place where we belong. That's why we sing.

previousepisode.name: Rock and Roll Will Never Die

name: Déjate ver
summary: Ana is the assistant to Bassil, one of the most famous artists on the planet. When she literally begins to disappear, she realizes she has to return home to rediscover the life she abandoned.

name: Chaque seconde compte
summary: Four strangers join forces to unanimously answer general knowledge questions. The longer the team takes to respond, the lower the prize will be. Here is THE game that will keep Quebecers in suspense.

name: Nudes
summary: French adaptation of the 2019 Norwegian original series

name: Les Oubliettes
summary: Emma, 26, owes an incredible amount of money to her creditors. Misanthropic but in over her head, she invents a passion for the Middle Ages to get a job at Les Oubliettes restaurant. After a series of strange events threaten to close the restaurant, the employees notice something special about Emma. Could she be the chosen one foretold by the Prophecy? At the crossroads between fantasy and the "real life" of the restaurant business, Emma finds herself reluctantly having to save the restaurant and its employees, who turn out to be the most loyal and brave people she's ever met.

name: Fleur Bleue
summary: Features Fleur and her various one-night stands in a single setting: her bed. In this intimacy, Fleur finds herself confronted with different characters each embodying a theme of our society: parenthood, politics, prejudices, gender equality, consent, ecology... Themes treated with humor which depict relationships today and the questions that arise from it.

name: Les Trésors de…
summary: Focuses on all the treasures that make up French heritage. From mansions to haute couture, to famous vineyards and castles, France is full of treasures to explore.

name: Domino Day
summary: Domino Day is a world record attempt for the highest number of toppling domino stones, organized from 1998-2009 by Endemol Netherlands. Together with Weijers Domino Productions of Robin Paul Weijers, also known as Mr. Domino, parties team up to set a new world record. The production is mainly organized at the WTC-Expo in Leeuwarden, Netherlands.

name: Untamed
summary: Untamed follows Kyle Turner, a special agent for the National Parks Service who works to enforce human law in nature's vast wilderness. The investigation of a brutal death sends Turner on a collision course with the dark secrets within the park, and in his own past.

name: Vazdušni most
summary: A unique undertaking - the largest single operation to rescue allied pilots in the history of world aviation, known as "Operation Haliard", which was carried out in the summer of 1944 by the Serbian people led by the Yugoslav Army in the homeland, under the leadership of General Draža Mihailović.

name: Baraa
summary: Youssef loves his son Islam very much and raises him to learn the teachings of the Islamic religion without exaggeration or racism and leaves his wife Maryam the freedom to pray and veil until she is convinced.

name: Three Tears in Boraco
summary: In the lush setting of the tropical forest of Boraco, three young brothers born in Taiwan and enlisted in the army of the Japanese empire, discover the violence of war.

name: La Chambre des dames
summary: Chronicles the life of a family living in the 13th century French capital, in the kingdom of Saint Louis, with the daily existence of the Brunels, goldsmiths in Paris, especially that of the women and, in particular, of two of them: Mathilde, the mother, thirty-four years old, and Florie, her daughter, fifteen years old, who is getting married.

name: Grand Palais Chicha Lounge
summary: Ouarda's hookah bar, Le Grand Palais, is threatened with closure due to the gentrification of the neighborhood. Jassim, a new recruit from a real estate developer firm, is responsible for buying the place. At all costs. Natural enemies, Ouarda and Jassim will nevertheless become closer and fall in love, despite themselves. But is their relationship possible when the success of one depends on the failure of the other? Without forgetting the young and handsome Treizor, Ouarda's occasional lover, who talentedly hosts the bar's evenings.

name: Komiker Utan Gränser
summary: Under the direction of Robin Paulsson, the shameless comedians Pernilla Wahlgren, Kristina Petrushina, Per Andersson and David Batra will perform various, more or less, difficult challenges in public places in Stockholm, Copenhagen and Oslo. It is done in front of hidden cameras and with ordinary people they meet.

name: War of Faith
summary: War of Faith tells the story of Wei Ruolai, a financial genius who serves as a low-level employee of the Kuomintang Central Bank from 1929 to 1934. He is mentored by the senior advisor Shen Tunan. In troubled times, he is confused and hesitant about the path he should choose. Under the influence of Shen Tunan's sister and Communist Party member Shen Jinzhen, he gradually establishes his communist beliefs and grows into a loyal financier who takes the lead in our party's financial front.

name: Please Teach Me
summary: The drama follows a delightful and heartwarming BL romance that blossoms as Doyoon, a leading acting student, and Siwoo, a renowned idol celebrated for his acting prowess, find themselves in the same acting workshop class.

name: The Ordinary Glory
summary: A workplace drama that follows a manager who has been repeatedly passed over for a promotion and his new intern. They work hard to make it in the financial sector in Shanghai.

name: Big Girls Don't Cry
summary: A new girl joins, old friends re-unite, and adventures ensue as another term begins at the all-girls boarding school nestled in the hills. Welcome to Vandana Valley!

name: The Oldest View
summary: An unexplained phenomenon lying on a forest unchains a series of unfortunate events for anyone who dares going near to it.

previousepisode.name: The Reamins of Valley View Mall (Post-Demolition)

name: Pocket Monster: Kami to Yobareshi Arceus
summary: While investigating the legend of the mythical Pokémon Arceus, Ash, Goh and Dawn uncover a plot by Team Galactic that threatens the world.

previousepisode.name: Miraculous Radiance! The Legend of Sinnoh!

name: Elle est pas belle la vie
Allt och Eva
summary: For 40 years, Eva has remained steadfast in her disbelief in love. Instead, she believes that happiness lies in her love for herself and her friends, a philosophy that has guided her well in her meticulously planned life. After deciding to get pregnant she goes to Copenhagen to get a sperm donor. Eva chooses an open donor who seems perfect. But the night before the big insemination, she can't help but think whether she made the right choice of donor. She decides to seek him out with a hidden agenda. He turns out to be normal, kind, nice and above all not a psychopath. Eva returns home to Stockholm satisfied, now with a small embryo in her uterus. Exactly according to plan. But the donor, Mads, can't stop thinking about Eva and has completely different plans - without knowing her secret.

name: Interview Uncut : 20 minutes de vérité
summary: These emblematic reality series candidates know each other, love each other, have loved each other and even sometimes betrayed each other... but have they told each other the whole truth? To find out, they agreed to take part in the Uncut interview game, a 20-minute face-to-face meeting with no language or way out... Because they will have to answer the questions of the one of their acquaintances… but without knowing his identity. And nothing, absolutely nothing, will be cut during editing!

name: Bad Dinosaurs
summary: A lovably mischievous Tyrannosaurus family explores their colorful prehistoric world, having slapstick fun with the silly dinosaurs who live there.

name: Survive the Tribe
summary: Survival instructor and wilderness guide Hazen Audel travels to some of the world's most remote tribal communities to learn how they have survived for thousands of years in the planet's toughest environments. Hazen joins tribes in the rainforests of Ecuador, the Kalahari Desert of Namibia, a remote island in the Pacific Ocean, the mountains of western Mongolia, the frozen Arctic of Canada, and in equatorial Kenya to learn firsthand the skills and traditions of these masters of survival.

name: The Twin
summary: Suffocating in a loveless marriage to Adam, Nicola's life takes a dramatic turn when Adam's long-estranged identical twin brother Lee comes crashing back into her life, and their tangled romantic past threatens to destroy the present. A split-second decision and a terrible accident drives Nicola to protect her children, and over the course of one week, Lee and Nicola are forced together, struggling to maintain a web of secrets and lies. Though they can't ignore their feelings for each other, they both know they're living on borrowed time.

name: Genius Game
summary: Genius Game is a brand-new reality game show that will see strategically minded players, chosen not just for their high intellectual prowess but also their social IQ, face the ultimate battle of survival. To win, contestants will participate in a host of never before seen games all designed to not only test their intellectual acumen but encourage them to carefully and creatively use the art of manipulation to outfox their opponents and win a cash prize.

name: Mandatory Path
summary: When a murder unites them, Hussein and Ali, two young men who have just learned they're brothers, must set their differences aside and solve the case.

name: North of North
summary: Siaja is a young Inuk mother who wants to build a new future for herself. After a spontaneous — and extremely public — exit from her marriage, Siaja has to find a job and a place for her and her young daughter to live, and fast. Her only option might be to go from one complicated living situation to another — where Siaja's dreams of a fresh start collide with some long-kept secrets. To top it all off, this is happening in a small Arctic town where everybody knows your business.

name: Secret Weapons of World War II
summary:
Secret Weapons of World War II explores the desperate weapons race fought by nations worldwide to gain an advantage over their adversaries. Incendiary bats, flying wings, rubber tanks, and guns that shoot around corners – in wartime, there is no such thing as a bad idea, but not all of these ideas worked or even made it beyond the planning stage. 

This riveting series tells the story of the weapons that changed history, and still impact our daily lives. Like the small top-secret device invented to improve radar, the magnetron – now found in most kitchens as a microwave. Learn about the inventions born out of desperation that resulted in jet engines, rockets, lasers, and computers. Beyond the apparent silliness of pigeon bombs and death rays, this fascinating series highlights innovative weaponry developed during the war and the resulting transformative technological revolution.

name: Nemlizade
summary: Kamil, the camera owner, comes to the neighborhood and encounters Onur in the neighborhood, and starts filming the events in Onur's life, and events follow one another.

name: BLANK - The Series
summary: Khun Nueng, M.L. Sipakorn, is a beautiful woman who's grown up under pressure from her grandmother. She's never been allowed to be herself, never met someone she could feel loved by or worthy of. Then she meets Anueng, cheerful and bright. Beneath the smiling face, however, there's a sadness hidden in her eyes. She makes her heart flutter like never before. Unfortunately, the sixteen years age difference, family and societal norms keep their love from flourishing.

name: Kikattava Kakkiainen
summary: Kikattava Kakkiainen, despite his small size, is a big hero with a captivating gift of laughter. It's catchy and puts everyone in a good mood. Kakkiainen's cheerful attitude to life is especially helpful to his friends Keijo Karhulle, Herra Hirvelle, Neiti Siilille and City Kanille who live in Havunhelman forest, who get into the strangest situations out of habit. Kakkiainen appears at the right moment to save the friends from the pit. It helps to see how perseverance and a positive attitude are the solutions to many problems.

name: Anton & Giovanni's Adventures in Spain
summary: Strictly's dancing duo Anton Du Beke and Giovanni Pernice – livin' la vida loca on an epic adventure across Anton's motherland. There's festivals, flamenco and friends old and new.

name: Henjin no Salad Bowl
summary: The story centers on Sōsuke Kaburaya, a poor detective who, while tailing someone one day, meets Sara Da Odin, a princess from another world with magical powers. They gradually start living together, and Sara is able to familiarize herself with modern day Japan in a flash. A female knight from Sara's world named Livia Do Udis also comes to this world, and lives the life of a homeless person, but she finds herself unexpectedly enjoying her new life. The story follows Sōsuke, these two strong-willed and positive women from another world, as well as other eccentric characters such as a brutish lawyer, a religious leader, and a divorce agent.

previousepisode.name: Valentine's in Gifu / The Legend Begins / The Princess Graduates / The Legend Ends / A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics

name: Karasu wa Aruji wo Erabanai
summary: The story is set in an alternate world called Yamauchi, ruled by the Yatagarasu clan, who are able to transform between human and crow forms. Yukiya, a beautiful and eccentric Yatagarasu boy, is chosen to serve the young prince. While encountering various events in the conspiracy-filled imperial court, he forms a strange master-servant relationship with the young prince.

name: Super Duper Bunny League
summary: The Super Duper Bunny League is here to battle danger in all its forms as they defend Important City and the world from their arch-nemesis (and accidental creator), the inept Dr. Fuzzleglove, and a ridiculous rogues' gallery of cartoony villains. Whether battling sweet-toothed space pirates, sizzling lava monsters, giant metal monkeys or hot dog-hungry dinosaurs, the Bunnies must combine their new superpowers to defend truth, justice, and especially free time to snack and chill.

name: Вкусно с Анфисой Чеховой
summary: The stars will come to visit Anfisa Chekhova's kitchen. Together they will feel nostalgic, discuss funny, sentimental and amazing incidents from life and prepare the hero's favorite dish from childhood. Will they turn out as tasty as before?

name: Miles from Nowhere
summary: A young Kiwi-Muslim songwriter named Said is having a crisis. His fiancee left him, his career's non-existent, and his mum worries he's losing touch with his faith. Said risks it all when he befriends an SIS agent.

name: Wilk
summary: One party will unexpectedly change the life of teenage Tymon, complicating his relationship with loved ones. Meanwhile, the real threat resulting from the wave of socio-political tensions is growing around everyone. People take to the streets en masse. The boy and his friends living in their own, hermetic world have to decide whether the attitude of passive observers of the reality changing before their eyes is sufficient for them.

name: The Real Serpent: Investigating a Serial Killer
summary: Former detectives re-open the file on suspected serial killer Charles Sobhraj, aka 'The Serpent', who agrees to be interrogated about several murders from the 1970s.

name: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring
summary: Takumi Kayano, a young, average Japanese man, was accidently killed by the Wind God Syl. As an apology, Syl imbued Takumi with the knowledge and skills necessary for survival, and had him reincarnated in the fantasy world of Etelldia. While exploring a dangerous forest filled with monsters, Takumi stumbled across a pair of young twins. After giving them names and forming a bond, he decides to raise them as his own as he explores this new world… What sort of adventures await the trio of Takumi, Alan, and Elena? Find out in the comic adaptation of the Alphapolis Fantasy Prize-winning story of a pair of cute twins and the adventurer who cares for them!

name: Wistoria: Wand and Sword
summary: Wistoria: Wand and Sword follows the adventures of Will Serfort, a young man driven by the dream of keeping a promise made to a childhood friend: to become a Magia Vander, one of the powerful magicians who sit at the top of the Tower of Wizards. But Will faces a major obstacle: he is unable to cast even the most basic spell. This forces him to fight monsters in dungeons to earn credits at the Regarden Magic Academy where he studies. Despite his lack of talent in magic, Will is blessed with exceptional sword skills, inherited from his mysterious past. At the heart of the Magic Academy, where strength and magic reign supreme, Will Serfort must navigate dangerous challenges and rivalries, while searching for a way to unlock his hidden magical potential.

previousepisode.name: A Story of a Dream With No End

name: No Longer Allowed in Another World
summary: An adventure in another world with cute girls by your side and video game-like powers--sounds like an anime fan's dream, right? Not so for melancholic author Osamu Dazai, who would quite literally prefer to drop dead. Video games haven't even been invented yet when he gets yanked into another world in 1948. Really, all the fantastical adventure he keeps running into is just getting in the way of his poetic dream of finding the perfect place to die. But no matter how much he risks his hide, everything seems to keep turning out okay. Follow a miserable hero like no other in this cheerfully bleak isekai comedy!

previousepisode.name: Tonight I Shall Die, I Ride So That It Will Kill Me

name: The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army Was a Human
summary: The humans are currently at war with the Demon Lord Army. The most notable of the army's elite is Ike, the commanding magician of the Immortal Brigade. Hailed as the Demon Lord Army's Confidante, Ike however has a secret to be kept from the demons around him, he is a actually a human, a regular human reincarnated from Japan!

name: The Zero Complaint Flight
summary: Wang Haixian joins an airline company's flight attendant interview to woo her crush, the flight attendant Li Er. The company employs a group of professional actors to simulate passengers in order to train the newcomers' adaptability. Throughout the training process, Wang Haixian gradually discovers the charm of the flight attendant profession and, along with her peers, resolves various challenging passenger issues.

name: The Motorola Television Hour
summary: The Motorola Television Hour is an hour-long anthology series which alternated bi-weekly with The United States Steel Hour on ABC. The show premiered on November 3, 1953 and was last aired on June 1, 1954. It was sponsored by Motorola.

name: Адмирал Кузнецов
summary: Nikolay Kuznetsov is a people's commissar who had to command the USSR Navy during the Great Patriotic War. Kuznetsov, an intelligent and subtle strategist who cares for the life of every sailor, invariably manages to emerge victorious from the most difficult situations.

name: Mahô Yûgi
summary: Padudu is a 12-year-old apprentice witch, chosen to represent her town in the coliseum. Donning her magical fish costume, which keeps her warm and fed, she sets off on her journey. But on the way she's swept away by a river to Dance Valley. Mayor Koffy captures her and throws her into the dungeon, hoping to eliminate the competition for Dance Valley's own coliseum candidate. Luckily for Padudu, this dungeon holds the mysterious witch Nonononn. They join together in a magical fight for survival. At the end of Blue Gender Trailer, the Magical witchland word came out!

name: Schlag den Raab
summary: Schlag den Raab is a live game show airing on the German television channel ProSieben on Saturday evenings. A total of six shows are produced and broadcast each year. A candidate who can beat Stefan Raab in a number of disciplines wins the jackpot.

name: Тайная жизнь
summary: Who is a master at solving riddles? Detectives of the Secret Life agency! Every now and then they encounter something unusual: an invisible thief, a mystical cheese factory, a killer gift for a fitness blogger, an assassination attempt on Napoleon - a modern one, of course. The main characters are detectives Volodya and Sasha, and two ambitious girls help them. Katya and Zhenya are sure that they can handle any mystery on their own, so they often come into conflict with the guys. This confrontation between male and female not only helps in investigations, but also adds intrigue to the characters' relationships.

name: Bimble's Bucket
summary:
Bimble's Bucket is fast, furious and funny. As a reward for a good deed Bimble gets a Magic Bucket, that gives him anything. Inside the bucket, lives the Guardian of the Bucket; cheerful Teeny Weeny.

There are others after the Bucket; lazy, greedy Queen Kak from gloomy Sleaze City and Dolly Clackhanger, a failed witch, whose bungled spells spread chaos. It's a miracle her assistant, Sploot, has survived. Dolly thinks the Bucket is what she needs to become a proper witch.

Queen Kak sends her minions, Bilge and Oila on their motorised pogo sticks and so begins an epic battle to possess the bucket. We go to the end of the rainbow, to the Great Golden Bucket in the sky and to the magical world inside the Bucket.

name: Microscopic Milton
summary: Animated adventures of a boy who's so small he lives in a clock on the mantelpiece, and the only one who knows he's there is a Shaggy dog.

name: Freefonix
summary: 3D animated music drive adventure series about three teenage bandmates who inadvertently discover The Thirteenth Note – a musical energy force which brings them power and insight.

name: Dawdle the Donkey
summary: Join Dawdle the Donkey as she enjoys adventures with Rola Polar and Archie the black and white cat.

name: Grace
summary: Grace follows a true-blue detective known for his brash, cynical style and a passionate, community-focused pastor who wears her heart on her sleeve reluctantly partner to solve complex crimes as they debate their divergent beliefs while attempting to ignore their growing chemistry.

name: Я вернусь за тобой
summary: Everything is good in Sergei's life - he is successful in the construction business, is dating a beautiful girl Leroy and plans to buy an apartment in Moscow. However, the past does not let him go - he constantly remembers his first love. Alina's life ended tragically right before the wedding - the girl was hit by a car, and her father, who was against the marriage, told Sergei that it was not possible to save her.

name: Ossan no Pants ga Nandatte Ii Janai ka!
summary: 50 year old Okita Makoto is a middle-aged man who is old-fashioned and prejudiced against certain people and behaviors. Because of his values, he is disliked by his son who likes cute things, his fujoshi daughter who likes BL, and his wife who is a fan of male idols. After meeting a gay young man, Makoto begins to slowly change his way of thinking.

name: Fall in Love Again
summary: Six years ago at a wedding at sea, the bride Zhou Mian is maliciously left at the altar. She falls into the sea and is rescued by Mai Ke. It is only then that she learns her fiancé Lu Yunkai is closely related to her parents' death. She forms a "Victim Alliance" with Mai Ke and is bent on revenge. Six years later, Zhou Mian returns to a domestic charity banquet as the top international designer He Erxin, facing Lu Yunkai head-on. Suspicious that He Erxin is his deceased wife Zhou Mian, Lu Yunkai tests her constantly. Zhou Mian does not give in and instead boldly joins Lu Yunkai's Wuxin Company. In order to expose each other's secrets and strategize against each other, the fake couple actually flirt with each other and almost get too intimate. Zhou Mian discovers that in the past six years, Lu Yunkai has never given up searching for her. There is more than meets the eye to the accident at her parents' toy factory, and Mai Ke repeatedly uses despicable means to urge Zhou Mian to defeat Lu Yunkai. At the last moment, Zhou Mian switches sides and joins forces with Lu Yunkai to resolve the crisis, uncover the truth, and rekindle their love.

name: Bondi Rescue Bali
summary: A spin-off of the original series, Bondi Rescue, this reality show takes place on Kuta Beach, Bali in Indonesia. The Bondi lifeguard team take on a two-month challenge of patroling a beach much larger and more dangerous than Bondi, in a more humid climate without all the recue equipment they are used to having on hand.

name: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio
summary: Yuhi Yugure and Yasumi Utatane, high school classmates and co-hosts of a weekly radio program, paint a picture-perfect friendship for their listeners. Yet, in reality, they couldn't be more different. Their off-air dynamic is a whirlwind of chaos and insults. As their tumultuous relationship unfolds, they navigate the turbulent waters of friendship and rivalry in the cutthroat realm of showbiz.

previousepisode.name: Yuhi and Yasumi Want to Break Through

name: RoOT
summary: Reina, a cool and lonely 19-year-old detective working in a small detective agency, teams up with unlucky but optimistic newbie Sato after an investigation into a small case in relation to a strange taxi driver leads them to be embroiled in a much bigger case.

name: Tiltott zónák
summary: The show takes viewers to secret places where no one, or only a few, have access. It introduces behind-the-scenes secrets that are unknown to the general public.

name: Le Réseau
summary: Overwhelmed by an intrusive mother, a girlfriend abroad and a socially unsuitable colleague, Joseph will do everything to prove that he has become someone.

name: Citoyens Clandestins
summary: The multiple maneuvers of a handful of police officers, soldiers and spies in paranoid post-September 11 France, targeted by an attempted attack, and the relentless quest for truth of a young idealistic journalist.

name: Gespe'gewa'gi: The Last Land
summary: Jump in first-hand into the exciting and sometimes dangerous day-to-day life of a handful of Mi'gmaq men and women who make their living on the waters of the Restigouche River and the Atlantic Ocean.

previousepisode.name: PRESTON: Finding his Footing at Sea

name: The New People
summary: A group of college students start their own society after their plane crashes on an island in the middle of the Pacific Ocean.

name: Gaeneun hullyunghada
summary: Korea's "Comedy King," Lee Gyeonggyu, who's also known for his love for dogs and the country's most famous dog expert, Kang Hyungwook, team up to study how the humans and the pets live in peace and harmony.

name: Les petits tannants
summary: What could be cuter and more entertaining than children's words and reactions? Nothing? That's good news: in the new family game Les petits tannants, hosted by Pierre Hébert, it's just that! In a studio that looks like a colorful games room equipped with hidden cameras, Pierre Hébert will be accompanied, for each program, by a well-known personality, including Anne-Élisabeth Bossé, Marie-Soleil Dion, Cynthia Wu-Maheu, Mario Tessier, Maxime Landry, Claude Cobra, Mathieu Baron, Alex Perron, Antoine Vezina, Phil Laprise and Phil Roy.

name: Belle-mère
summary: Frédérique, Christophe and Geneviève decide to form their own support group for in-laws in order to confide in each other, but above all to vent about their not always easy daily life!

name: Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san
summary: Takagi loves to tease, and her victim is none other than her next-seat classmate, Nishikata. She knows too well of Nishikata that it's almost impossible to get back at her. But this won't dispirit a determined Nishikata who is always looking for a chance to give Takagi a taste of her own medicine.

name: My Stand-In
summary:
Joe, the stunt man of famous actor Tong, happened to meet Ming. Having developed a deep relationship, Joe didn't realise that Ming had always seen him as Tong's replacement. When the truth is revealed, Joe has to take work on a foreign set where an accident takes his life. 

When he wakes, Joe's in the body of a young man named Joe who'd met with an accident on the same day. With help, he's soon living the same life as he was before—with the same people—and he meets Ming once more. In this life, Ming wants Joe back at his side as before and Joe doesn't know why. Ming, who's kept all memories of the old Joe, tries to find the truth about Joe's continued life in order to return Joe to his side and give him the explanation he never had the chance to.

previousepisode.name: Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.

name: Roof of the World
summary:
The Third Pole (Roof of the World) shows us how Tibetan people live in harmony with nature in an extreme environment, immersing us in the unique charms of Tibet. What we are trying to depict for you are here is the relationship between people living in Tibetan Plateau and nature. We will focus on the incredible and unique nature state, continuous and erect snow mountains, rich and productive land steps, cyclical and round streams, soil and nature, animals, plants, and men coexisting and surviving together on earth.

The documentary series The Third Pole (Roof of the World) is China's first documentary about Tibetans living in harmony with nature on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. With nature as the backdrop and human activities as the core, it also reflects the inheritance of traditional Tibetan culture, the continuation of traditional lifestyles, and the way the natural environment is being protected. It was released to wide international acclaim and has been regarded as a Chinese TV documentary that has gained significant international recognition. TV and Internet broadcasts have spurred wide interest in the documentary. We find The Third Pole significantly different from previous documentaries about Tibet through its strenuous efforts to gain insights into Tibet, leading to a "rediscovery" of this land and its people. The Third Pole provides insightful depictions of Tibetan people's everyday life, showing situations in which common Tibetan people attend to their daily business and capturing their stories with sensitivity. The sweep of this documentary's camera presents viewers with authentic pictures of Tibet's natural and human environment and specific individuals living therein. A striking feature of this documentary lies in its faithful representation of ordinary people's lifestyles at the "Third Pole," which is the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau as seen through an anthropological lens. In Tibet's extreme environment, people have settled on an optimal lifestyle that this documentary shows in an ordinary yet amazing way, opening a space wherein the audience can admire the sublimity of human life in this world. It is a song of humanity; it is a song of nature.

name: Fan de
summary: After more than 10 years of absence, Fan de is making a comeback through a new formula completely redesigned around today's stars: influencers. And for the occasion, the show will allow a fan to live a unique and unforgettable experience: a surprise and exclusive meeting with his favorite star. Greg Yega, Julien Bert, Victoria Mehault, Hilona Gos and Bastos lent themselves to the game and gave one of their fans an incredible day.

name: Казачок
summary:
After several failed exams, the parents send the high school student Stepa for summer holidays to the village to his grandmother. A summer without the Internet is the worst punishment for a modern teenager. One day, running away from the local guys, Stepa accidentally falls into a well, and gets out in the same place, but in the 17th century, when his grandmother's village was a Cossack village. Stepa has only a campfire and a few gadgets with a power bank with him, which help him in the first minutes of his new life. Stepa understands that if his ancestors had had gadgets in the 17th century, the course of history could have turned out to be completely different.

He, a guy who was born in the digital age, will have to survive in times of grandiose riots and changes and learn in practice a history lesson that was filled up at school. And Stepa accepts this challenge with humor. An incredible summer adventure awaits him with a real boyish friendship, the first romantic relationship and important internal transformations.

name: Extreme Animal Transport
summary: A specialist team from around the world must use extreme care to transport wild animals across international lines.

name: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
summary: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice, and so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. On this bonus season of Air Crash Investigation, every episode examines multiple cases under a central theme: Rookie Errors reveals the minor mistakes behind some of the worst-ever airline disasters; Collision Course follows the scramble to prevent yet another midair impact; and, on Fuel Failures, a mysterious trail of clues ultimately leads to the fuel tank.

name: Secrets of Modern Archaeology
summary: Explores how cutting-edge technology and science have pushed the boundaries of archaeological studies and filled in some of the gaps in history.

name: Behind the Wheel with MotorTrend
summary: "Behind the Wheel" on MotorTrend is your go-to show for in-depth new-car reviews. Our hosts Jonny Lieberman, Kristen Lee and Joe Berry take you on exhilarating rides in the year's most notable vehicles. Experience candid, unfiltered opinions on the latest cars, trucks and SUVs from industry experts. Get ready to hit the road with us for an honest look at what's driving the automotive industry.

name: Monochrome: Black, White and Blue
summary: Jon Brewer explores the history of blues music and the plight of the people in America's deep south. Through insightful interviews and live performances, a story of the blues is told.

name: Silk Road from Above
summary: An aerial adventure along the world's most famous trade route, with drone visuals and satellite imagery bringing alive the rich history, long-lasting legacy and grandeur of the Silk Road.

name: Beast Games
summary: From the groundbreaking mind of MrBeast comes a new, record-breaking competition series. A staggering 1,000 players compete in nail-biting, physical, mental, and social challenges, for a chance to win a whopping $5 million dollar cash prize. Week by week, players will use their strength and wit to stay in the game, with the hope of being the multi-million-dollar winner.

name: Styled
summary: Styled follows the staging and renovation adventures of Nicole Babb and Caffery Vanhorne, best friends and design experts, as they transform spaces from drab to fab. With help from Nicole's family-owned interior design business and a team of skilled contractors by their side, this dynamic design duo brings their vision to life on projects big and small. Whether adding value to a property before it hits the market, or turning a house into a forever home, Nicole and Caffery elevate each space with glamour and style.

name: Guess Who I Am
summary: According to legend, there is a person in the rivers and lakes who makes the rich and scumbags turn their faces. She specializes in rectifying the scumbags and never fails. This girl is named Song Yao. All this depends on the fantasy system she has-attracting rich people. Any rich man worth hundreds of millions will fall in love with her irresistibly as long as he looks at her. However, no matter how powerful the system is, there will be a day when it encounters Waterloo: Song Yao's pair of magical electric eyes actually failed in the Chengtian Group's prince "Ji Chengchuan". But Song Yao didn't know, it was all because the prince in front of him was a counterfeit - the liar Qin Hao. In this way, two playwrights with their own minds met, destined to start a fight like Mr. and Mrs. Smith. When a trench-sucking girl bumps into a liar boy, who can outwit them. And behind Song Yao's life experience, what secrets are hidden?

name: Fortune Writer
summary: Su Yunqi, the legitimate daughter of the Prime Minister, accidentally discovers that she is the supporting character in the The Book of Fate, with her fate set within. Facing with such an unjust fate, Su Yunqi chooses to rebel. She intends to use the The Book of Fate to defy fate, to seek her true self and to harvest sincere love!

name: Great Irish Interiors
summary: Great Irish Interiors, a three part series, follows the fascinating work of historical interior experts as they transform Doneraile Court, Emo Court and Kylemore Abbey. Focusing on the race to return the interiors of these buildings to their former glory, we reveal fascinating and previously unseen work done by historical interiors experts as they source, beg, borrow and steal furniture, artwork and precious artefacts for their sites in time to open these stunning buildings to the public for the tourist season.

name: Ensam i vildmarken
summary: Eight participants try to survive for as long as they can in the Norwegian wilderness where they are completely isolated from the outside world.

name: Photographer
summary: World-renowned photographers embark on visually stunning adventures where every frame tells an inspiring and evocative story.

name: The Bad Foot Clinic
summary: Leading podiatrist Marion Yau and her GP husband Dr Kenny, tackle the most extreme foot problems imaginable, changing lives along the way.

name: Shed & Buried: Classic Cars
summary:
Shed & Buried: Classic Cars sees Henry team-up with Fuzz Townshend once again. The duo will be doing what they do best: digging in the nation's sheds, barns and outbuildings, this time to (hopefully) find a tidy profit in some vintage motors.

Henry's love of motorbikes and tractors is well-known, but he still has a soft spot for classic cars. Fuzz - who has an encyclopaedic knowledge of all things automotive - is the perfect partner to help him unearth some classic four-wheelers and turn them into nice little earners.

That's only half the battle - once their finds are back in the shed, restorer extraordinaire Guy Willison and engineering genius Allen Millyard will be put to the test, turning the rusty wrecks the lads have unearthed into right royal runners.

As always, Henry will need to keep Fuzz focused, to make sure he doesn't buy an obscure vintage bus or lorry. Fuzz will have to keep an eye on Henry too, as he's usually done a deal before Fuzz can even lift the bonnet.

name: Morning on Merit Street
summary: Time is such a valuable thing, especially in the morning. How you spend those first few hours can set the tone for the entire day. At Merit Street, we're building a new morning show that values your time as our guiding principle. Hosted by Dominique Sachse and Fanchon Stinger, a morning news show that combines information, entertainment, and inspiration.

name: Crime Stories with Nancy Grace
summary: Nancy Grace is an award-winning and respected legal commentator, victims' rights advocate, broadcast personality, and The New York Times bestselling author of four books. Grace has dedicated her life to fighting for the rights of victims of crime and their families. Now, the outspoken and passionate former prosecutor explores the inside stories of true crimes — ripped from today's headlines — as well as cold cases waiting for new leads. Grace aims to bring closure and justice to families still grappling with the pain of unresolved tragedies. New one-hour episodes air daily at 6PM ET, only on Merit Street.

name: The News on Merit Street
summary: Discussing the top headlines of the day, with a deeper dive into the facts, figures, circumstances, and history of the story.

name: The Behavior Panel
summary: Renowned top body language and behavioral analysts, Mark Bowden, Greg Hartley, Chase Hughes, and Scott Rouse, collectively known as The Behavior Panel, bring their expertise to Merit Street. For years they have provided the military, law enforcement, and Fortune 500 companies with expert interpretation of the gestures, fidgets, posture, and speech patterns that reveal human behavior. From YouTube, where videos amassed over 4M views, the panel's weekly show will analyze the news conferences, interviews, and public appearances by headline-makers that capture worldwide attention. Viewers will learn the signs of dishonesty and deception to keep them safe. One-hour episodes air Fridays at 4PM ET.

name: Cocoricó
summary: Julius, a simple 8-year-old boy who was born in the big city, goes to spend his school holidays at Cocorico Farm, his grandparents' farm in the fictional city of Cocoricolândia, a magical, enchanting place where animals talk, sing, and dance.

name: Skiftet
summary: The year is 1958, and Sweden's first female police officers graduate; a small group of pioneers taking a big step for gender equality but struggling to take even the smallest step themselves, as the skirts they're forced to wear chafe like sandpaper against their thighs. They are ridiculed by the public, belittled by the media, and scorned by their colleagues. The new recruits are placed in the country's most crime-ridden district; the Klara police district in Stockholm, and as they start patrolling the streets of Stockholm, they soon realise that their biggest problem isn't the criminals; instead, the resistance comes from colleagues and the society as a whole.

previousepisode.name: Är det så här det fungerar?

name: Sunday Night with Matty Johns
summary:
Sunday Night with Matty Johns is an Australian sports television series which began airing on Fox Sports on 4 March 2013. The show, previously on Monday nights, changed to Sunday night in 2018.

Now, in 2024 Matty Johns hosts The Late Show with Matty Johns on Thursdays, where he is joined on the couch by Fletch, Hindy & Gordie. Following the conclusion of the NRL Round, Matty Johns is joined by Fletch & Hindy once again with a special guest to wrap up the round of footy. Laurie Daley joins the panel as the TAB representative on both Thursday and Sunday nights.

name: Bakemesterskapet
summary: Layer upon layer of cream and icing - there will be both spills, goo and impressive pastries when Norway's best hobby baker is chosen. Happy dough!

name: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
summary: In this new series, chef Mark Moriarty brings easy-to-follow recipes that will arm you with a brand-new repertoire of dishes, using simple, fresh ingredients, with very little fuss.

previousepisode.name: Off Duty Chef: Bringing It Home Christmas Special

name: The Complaints Bureau
summary: The Complaints Bureau sees finance expert Eoin McGee set the caseload for three consumer journalists attempting to solve the problems of Irish consumers.

name: Project Wild
summary: Nature nerd Dr Ann Jones travels through the Indo-Pacific region to find the dedicated people bringing our planet's amazing animals, plants and ecosystems back from the brink.

name: Paris 7000
summary: Stories of an American embassy official based in Paris, France.

name: Our Living World
summary: This stunning nature series narrated by Cate Blanchett explores the intelligence, resourcefulness and interconnectedness of life on our planet.

name: Receiver
summary: Receiver follows five of the NFL's best pass catchers throughout the 2023 season on and off the field: Davante Adams, Justin Jefferson, George Kittle, Deebo Samuel and Amon-Ra St. Brown.

name: Secuestro del vuelo 601
summary: Two armed revolutionaries hijack and threaten to blow up Flight 601 unless the Colombian government releases 50 political prisoners and pays them a large cash ransom. Faced with political leaders' refusal to negotiate, the aggressors make drastic decisions that will jeopardize the hostages' safety as the plane flies aimlessly. Amid the impending horror, the captain and two brave stewardesses must fight to return the hostages safely and outwit the hijackers while negotiating with the authorities. This is a breathtaking thriller inspired by true events that took place on May 30, 1973.

name: Ctrl+Alt+Desire
summary: Ctrl+Alt+Desire exposes a chilling tale of addiction, deceit and online obsession. Amato's life descended into chaos when he stumbled into the world of live-stream cam models and immediately fell head over heels in love with Silvie, a Bulgarian cam girl. The series taps into four years of prison phone calls recorded from a contraband cell phone and clues scattered across Florida, Eastern Europe and the deep web to reveal a story far more complex than expected.

name: Dil Dosti Dilemma
summary: Asmara's summer takes a turn when she's sent to her grandparents' neighbourhood as punishment. To save face, she pretends to be in Canada to her friends. Amid the traditional setting, she finds genuine friendships, life lessons, and a hint of romance. Yet, her hidden truth could ruin everything, Can she find the courage to be herself? Get ready for a story of friendship, growth, and twists!

name: Andhera
summary: In the shadow of Mumbai's shimmering skyline, a sinister force hunts the living. In this visceral tale of urban horror, a fearless cop and a haunted medical student must take on this living darkness to avert impending doom.

name: Khauf
summary: Madhu moves into a hostel in Delhi to start afresh, but her room hides a sinister presence that begins to get stronger each day, alarming the other women on her floor. They know what the room hides and desperately want her gone before it is too late for them all.

name: Inspector Rishi
summary: A sceptic crime branch Inspector Rishi Nandhan assisted by his two trusted sub-inspectors Ayyanar and Chitra, investigates a series of bizarre murders in a small mountain village, supposedly committed by a deadly forest spirit called the Vanaratchi.

name: Snakes & Ladders
summary: Curated by Karthik Subbaraj, set in the 2000s, this story is about four reckless kids trying to cover up an accidental crime, only to find themselves caught in worse situations - chased by cops, dim-witted thugs, and their own bad choices!

name: Call Me Bae
summary: Downsized from heiress to hustler, Bella 'Bae' Chowdhary played by Ananya Panday discovers her most valuable assets aren't her diamonds, but her street smarts and style. Broke, but refusing to be broken, she navigates the newsrooms of Mumbai, finding beaus, behens, and her better self while breaking big news.

name: The Tribe
summary: The Tribe is a reality series about 5 young Indian influencers who want to make it big in Los Angeles – the global capital of entertainment. Funding & fueling this audacious vision is a young Indian entrepreneur, Hardik Zaveri who knows no limits - to his vision and how much he is willing to spend on it. Are they onto something bigger than themselves or are they doomed to crash and burn?

name: Dupahiya
summary: A village prepares for its 25th anniversary of being crime-free when a prized motorbike vanishes. With a jubilee trophy, wedding, and town pride at risk, a frantic search to recover the bike before it's too late ensues.

name: Ziddi Girls
summary: Five girls navigate college under a strict principal, facing challenges while discovering friendship, love, and ambition. At Matilda House, they support each other, finding their voices and shaping their futures as change-makers.

name: Follow Kar Lo Yaar
summary: Uorfi Javed is India's biggest viral sensation - where she goes, drama follows. Her infamy and her clothes are self made! But now with the help of her new talent agency, Uorfi wants to go beyond and tweak her professional perception. At the same time, she also has to keep her loving but fully dysfunctional family together. Will this eternal hustler fight her way through?

name: Rangeen
summary: After discovering his wife's betrayal, a straight-laced husband dives into the hidden world of paid intimacy as a twisted act of revenge. Clueless and out of his depth, he stumbles through misadventures that mix awkward hilarity with raw self-discovery - forcing him to question his notions of love, manhood, and morality.

name: Daldal
summary: Rita Ferreira, the youngest DCP of the Mumbai Crime Branch, must battle a patriarchal mindset at work and her own impostor syndrome as she embarks on an investigation that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded killer.

name: Arabia Kadali
summary: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

name: Chhorii
summary: Chhorii is the story of a modern, young couple, Sakshi and Hemant. Sakshi is eight months pregnant with her first child when the couple, forced out of their home, escapes from the city and seeks refuge in a house located deep inside sugarcane fields. The house is inhabited by an old couple who seem to know more than they tell.

name: Crime Stories with Nancy Grace
summary: TV journalist and former prosecutor Nancy Grace comments about investigations into shocking crimes and asks tough questions.

name: The Good Daughter
summary: The Good Daughter is a suspenseful crime drama where sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she's forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

name: He's Mine
summary: HE'S MINE is the story of love and hate and the dangerous lies that happen between two lovers and the fear of losing someone you love most. The story happens in a beautiful beach resort where all the characters meet. This the story of relationships between families of different walks of life, between friends, between lovers as well as between enemies.

name: Mua Sao Dau Tien
summary: Thien Bao and Dinh Huy accidentally met on a blind date when Huy was hired to be the lover of a girl who came to force Bao to refuse the arranged marriage between him and that girl. The meeting seemed like very terribleas as Huy's plan, they thought they would never see each other again. Unfortunately, the CEO of company Huy applied to be an intern was Thien Bao.

name: New Amsterdam: Tomorrow
summary: New Amsterdam: Tomorrow will be set 30 years in the future and will explore the role of artificial intelligence in advancing medicine as Luna steps into her father's role as Medical Director of New Amsterdam Hospital.

name: Универ. Молодые
summary: Five first-year students move into the legendary 510 block of the Moscow State University dormitory. There they will be met by Pavel Vladimirovich Zuev, who decided to return to the university to make it the best in the country again; the new commandant of the hostel Tamara Mikhailovna — Zoya Mikhailovna's sister; her wayward assistant Kisel; "dumpling king" Kuzya, who became the main sponsor of the Moscow State University, and Vika Bobr, who plunged into teaching after parting with Anton Martynov. The guys are waiting for all the same problems: studying, relationships and finding themselves. At the same time, it is important not to forget that being a student is the best years of life, and try to "learn not to worry about trifles."

name: House of Guinness
summary: Dublin, 1868. The Guinness family patriarch is dead, and his four children -- each with dark secrets to hide -- hold the brewery's fate in their hands.

previousepisode.name: Le bonnetier de la rue Tripette

name: Vidocq
summary: This series, inspired by the memoirs of Eugène-François Vidocq, chronicles the adventures of a former convict who becomes a policeman in the early 19th century. In these new tales, Vidocq encounters a captivating "baroness" who is a formidable gang leader. The cases assigned to Vidocq involve not only police investigations but also delicate political and diplomatic matters. The series was presented in the Gallimard edition (1973) with the following description: "Escaping from prison, becoming the head of the Sûreté, and accepting increasingly important police and political missions, all while knowing he could be thrown back into chains if he fails—such is the incredible yet true story of Vidocq."
